title: Understand your Grafana Cloud bill and set up billable usage alerts

blocks.content: Spend climbing this month? Find what's driving it, then set an alert before your bill closes. First, open the Usage page.
Open the **Usage** page in Cost Management and Billing.
blocks.tooltip: This page shows what you're being charged for this billing period.

blocks.content: Pop this guide out into a floating window. The next steps open panels in Grafana that would otherwise cover it.
blocks.tooltip: A floating guide stays visible while Grafana opens its own side panels.

blocks.content: Usage is where your spend lives. Let's look at the numbers behind your bill.
**Total spend this period** is what you've used so far. Your bill isn't final yet.
blocks.tooltip: This is the headline figure that adds up everything you've used this period.

blocks.content: **Spend by product** shows what drives that total. Watch the biggest one.
blocks.tooltip: Each row shows how much of your total comes from one product, so the biggest contributors stand out.

blocks.content: Now set a spend alert, so you hear about the next jump while you can still act.
Select **Create your first usage alert** in the sidebar. You don't need to navigate anywhere yourself.
blocks.tooltip: This opens the alert form with your total spend as the thing to watch.

blocks.content: Check the **Alert type** is a threshold alert, which watches your spend against your set limit.
blocks.tooltip: This confirms the alert compares your overall spend with a limit.

blocks.content: Set the **Dollar threshold** to a monthly amount that makes sense for you. **Do it** sets it to $500, but you can edit this.
blocks.tooltip: The alert watches your spend against this monthly amount.

blocks.content: Under **Select alert levels**, set the percentage of your threshold. **Do it** sets it to 75%, so with the suggested values you'll be notified when spend reaches $375. You can edit this.
blocks.tooltip: An alert level is required before the alert can be created.

whenTrue.content: Choose who should hear about it in **Contact point**. **Create alert** stays disabled until you pick one.
whenTrue.tooltip: Pick where the notification should land, such as email or Slack. A contact point is required.

whenTrue.content: Select **Create alert** to save it. This creates a real alert that sends notifications.
whenTrue.tooltip: Creating the alert starts real notifications to your chosen contact point.

whenFalse.content: No contact point is available. Create one in **Manage contact points**, or ask an Alerting administrator to do so, then return here to finish the alert.
whenFalse.tooltip: A notification destination is required before an alert can be created.

blocks.content: Once you've created the alert, you're all set: when your spend approaches your threshold ($500 in this example), you'll be notified. You can change the amount any time in **Usage Alerts**.
